card.title: Samsung Galaxy A13 5G(A137) No fast Charging and Not connecting to PC

source.title: Samsung Galaxy A13 5G(A137) No fast Charging and Not connecting to PC

symptoms: works from one plug orientation only

claims.statement: Galaxy A13 5G data/fast-charge faults come from the DP/DM data lines or the CC1/CC2 lines (fast charge negotiation); fast charge on one side only plus data both sides points at CC.
DP and DM should read about the same in diode mode, as should CC1 and CC2; OL/low DP/DM can be jumpered to the CPU; a short may mean a bad CPU; CC faults mean reball/replace the charging IC.
If board readings are fine but a tail-plug tester shows OL, replace the port, then the screen (the main flex runs through it) or sub board, or jumper board to sub board.

procedure: Test the port with a tail-plug tester.
Diode-compare DP vs DM and CC1 vs CC2 at the main connector.
Jumper open DP/DM; reball/replace charging IC for CC faults.
Replace port, screen or sub board as indicated.
card.caveats: Reference values in images; measured with a DT-17N. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
